summary: Payette NF site in Idaho County, ID, inside the River of No Return Wilderness: 1929 tree platform and cabin remain; 46-ft steel tower removed in 1977 or 1981; NHLR-registered 1999.

facts.design: tree platform and log cabin remain; former 46-foot Aermotor steel tower with 7 by 7 foot cab
facts.status_note: 46-foot steel tower removed (1977 per firelookout.com, 1981 per NHLR); tree platform and log cabin remain

access.note: Within the Frank Church-River of No Return Wilderness on the Payette National Forest. No source gives a route or an open or closed status.

visit.trail_note: Firelookout.com places the site 8 miles south of Chamberlain G.S. No source gives a route.

events.note: First facility: tent camp and tree platform (NHLR; platform remains). Firelookout.com also says the 1929 site had a log cabin, which NHLR dates to 1937.
46-foot steel tower erected (Forest Lookouts; firelookout.com says constructed 1934). NHLR dates the tower to 1937.
NHLR: Rocky Mountain style log cabin and 46-foot Aermotor steel tower with 7 by 7 foot cab added
Firelookout.com: 46-foot steel tower gone in 1977. NHLR gives 1981.
NHLR: tower removed in 1981; other structures remain. Firelookout.com gives 1977.
Registered March 1, 1999 as US 310, ID 29; nominated by Gary Weber, Idaho Registrar

corrections.proposed: remove, or record as the former tower height (46 ft)
corrections.why: The 46-foot steel tower was removed in 1977 or 1981. The standing structures are the tree platform and log cabin, so no current tower height is supported. 14.0 m matches the former tower's 46 feet.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says the 46-foot tower was added in 1937. Forest Lookouts and firelookout.com say it was erected or constructed in 1934. The sources conflict, and the story reports both.
Firelookout.com says the tower was gone in 1977. NHLR says it was removed in 1981. The story reports both.
Firelookout.com says the 1929 site already had a log cabin. NHLR says the log cabin was added in 1937. The story reports both.
NHLR gives 8,327 ft (2,538 m), which matches the brief's 2538.1 m. Firelookout.com gives 8360 ft. The register figure is used in the story, and the other is noted.

sources.title: Rock Rabbit Point Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Brief's height_m 14.0 belongs to a tower that is no longer standing. See corrections. The NHLR, firelookout.com and Forest Lookouts pages agree on the 1929 tree platform and on the tower being removed, but disagree on the tower's build year (1934 or 1937), removal year (1977 or 1981) and cabin date (1929 or 1937). Elevation also differs by about 33 ft. No staffing history was found in the sources read. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page was not read, so its history section is not used. A Payette National Forest Facebook post in search snippets says the 1929 platform was first and that the log cabin was built later, but the page would not load, so it is not cited. A University of Idaho archival photo labelled 1951 Rock Rabbit Lookout, Big Creek is noted only from a search snippet; no URL or licence was checked, so no photo is listed. Keeping Watch coordinates (45.26107, -115.2389) match the brief. Current condition and access (2026) are unverified.
